Watch Chandragupta Maurya Episode - 71 now!
Synopsis :
Seleucus assumes that Amatya Rakshas is behind the attack. He orders his soldiers to attack Amatya Rakshas and kill him. They fail to kill Amatya Rakshas because of Chandragupta's intervention. Chandragupta follows the attackers and learns that those are Seleucus's men. Despite learning about Seleucus's conspiracy, Chandragupta hides about it from Dhananand and puts the blames on Chanakya's scholars. Later, Chandragupta informs Chanakya via gesticulation about the implementation of his plan to become close to Seleucus.
